FormItem.name: jdbcSource
FormItem.parameter:
<Panel layout="Grid" columns="1">
	<Group text="panel_database" layout="grid" columns="1">

		<Composite layout="Grid" columns="3">
			<Label text="panel_dbtype"/>
			<Combo name="template" readonly="true" onchange="chooseTemplate">
				<Value text="JDBC" name="customForm"/>
				<Value url="jdbc:db2://{hostname}{:port}/{database}" driver="com.ibm.db2.jcc.DB2Driver" type="radio" name="DB2" text="DB2"/>
				<Value url="jdbc:derby://{hostname}{:port}/{database}" driver="org.apache.derby.jdbc.ClientDriver" type="radio" name="Derby" text="Derby"/>
				<Value url="jdbc:derby://{database}" driver="org.apache.derby.jdbc.EmbeddedDriver" type="radio" name="DerbyEmbedded" text="Derby Embedded"/>
				<Value url="jdbc:sqlserver://{hostname}{:port};databaseName={database}" driver="com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.SQLServerDriver" type="radio" name="MSSQL" text="MS/SQL" />
				<Value url="jdbc:oracle:thin:@{hostname}{:port}:{database}" driver="oracle.jdbc.driver.OracleDriver" type="radio" name="Oracle" text="Oracle Net" />
				<Value url="jdbc:solid://{hostname}{:port}" driver="solid.jdbc.SolidDriver" type="radio" name="SolidDB" text="Solid DB" />
			</Combo>
			
			<LayoutData fill="horizontal"/>
		</Composite>

		<Composite name="config" layout="Stack">

			<Composite name="custom" layout="Grid" columns="3">
				<Label name="source_label" text="source_label"/>
				<Text required="true" linklabel="source_label" name="jdbcSource" binding="jdbcSource" tooltip="source_desc">
					<LayoutData fill="horizontal"/>
				</Text>
				<Button text="?">
					<Script name="onclick">
						panel.showParamSubstEditor(config, "jdbcSource", form.translate("source_desc"), form.translate("source_label"), false, true);
					</Script>
				</Button>
							
				<Label name="driver_label" text="driver_label" />
				<Text required="true" linklabel="driver_label" name="jdbcDriver" binding="jdbcDriver" tooltip="driver_desc">
					<LayoutData fill="horizontal"/>
				</Text>
				<Button text="?">
					<Script name="onclick">
						panel.showParamSubstEditor(config, "jdbcDriver", form.translate("driver_desc"), form.translate("driver_label"), false, true);
					</Script>
				</Button>
			</Composite>

			<Composite name="form" layout="Grid" columns="4" onchange="updateURL">
				<Label name="hostlabel_1" text="panel_hostname"/>
				<Text required="true" linklabel="hostlabel_1" name="hostname" size="12"/>
				<Label text="panel_port"/>
				<Text name="port" size="4"/>
				<Label name="dblabel_1" text="panel_database"/>
				<Text required="true" linklabel="dblabel_1" name="database" horizontalSpan="3">
					<LayoutData fill="horizontal"/>
				</Text>
			</Composite>

			<Composite name="form_embedded" layout="Grid" columns="2" onchange="updateURL">
				<Label name="dblabel_2" text="panel_database"/>
				<Text required="true" name="database2" linklabel="dblabel_2" >
					<LayoutData fill="horizontal"/>
				</Text>
			</Composite>

			<Composite name="form_solid" layout="Grid" columns="4" onchange="updateURL">
				<Label name="hostlabel_1" text="panel_hostname"/>
				<Text required="true" linklabel="hostlabel_1" name="hostname2" size="12"/>
				<Label text="panel_port"/>
				<Text name="port2" size="4"/>
			</Composite>

			<LayoutData fill="both" />
			
		</Composite>
	</Group>
	
	<Group layout="Fill" text="panel_login">
		<Composite layout="Grid" columns="4">
			
			<Label name="login_label" text="login_label" horizontalAlignment="RIGHT" />
			<Text linklabel="login_label" name="jdbcLogin" binding="jdbcLogin" fill="horizontal" horizontalSpan="2" tooltip="login_desc" />
			<Button text="?">
				<Script name="onclick">
					panel.showParamSubstEditor(config, "jdbcLogin", form.translate("login_desc"), form.translate("login_label"), false, true);
				</Script> 
			</Button>
			
			<Label name="pass_label" text="pass_label" horizontalAlignment="RIGHT" />
			<Text linklabel="pass_label" name="jdbcPassword" binding="jdbcPassword" fill="horizontal" horizontalSpan="2" password="true" />
			<Button text="?">
				<Script name="onclick">
					panel.showParamSubstEditor(config, "jdbcPassword", null, form.translate("pass_label"), false, true);
				</Script>
			</Button>
			
			<Label name="schema_label" text="schema_label" horizontalAlignment="RIGHT" />
			<Text linklabel="schema_label" name="jdbcSchema" binding="jdbcSchema" fill="horizontal" horizontalSpan="2" />
			<Button text="?">
				<Script name="onclick">
					panel.showParamSubstEditor(config, "jdbcSchema", null, form.translate("schema_label"), false, true);
				</Script>
			</Button>
			
			<Label name="table_label" text="table_label" horizontalAlignment="RIGHT"/>
			<Text required="true" linklabel="table_label" name="jdbcTable" binding="jdbcTable" fill="horizontal" tooltip="table_desc" />
			<Button text="table_script_label">
				<Script name="onclick">
					importPackage(Packages.com.ibm.tdi.eclipse);
   					var sel;
					conn = form.loadConnector();
					try {
						conn.initialize (null);
						sel = form.chooseFromList (Messages.getString("FormUI.Localized.Select.Table"), conn.queryTables());
						conn.terminate();
   					} catch (e) {
						conn.terminate();
						throw e;
					}
					if (sel != null) {
						if ( sel.indexOf(" ") != -1 )
							sel = "'" + sel + "'";
						form.setConfig("jdbcTable", sel);
						panel.getControl("jdbcTable").setText(sel);
					}
				</Script>
			</Button>
			<Button text="?">
				<Script name="onclick">
					panel.showParamSubstEditor(config, "jdbcTable", form.translate("table_desc"), form.translate("table_label"), false, true);
				</Script> 
			</Button>
			<LayoutData fill="horizontal"/>
		</Composite>
	</Group>

	<Script>
	
		selectedTemplate = null;
		
		function on_load() {
			combo = panel.getControl("template");
			try {
				str = config.getStringParameter("custom.form");
				if(str != null) {
					var index;
					try {
						index = java.lang.Integer.parseInt(str);
					} catch (e) {
						index = combo.indexOf(str);
					}
					if (index > 0) {
						combo.select(index);
						panel.setText("hostname", config.getStringParameter("custom.hostname"));
						panel.setText("hostname2", config.getStringParameter("custom.hostname2"));
						panel.setText("port", config.getStringParameter("custom.port"));
						panel.setText("port2", config.getStringParameter("custom.port2"));
						panel.setText("database", config.getStringParameter("custom.database"));
						panel.setText("database2", config.getStringParameter("custom.database"));
						if(index == 3)
							panel.setTopControl("config", "form_embedded");
						else if(index == 6)
							panel.setTopControl("config", "form_solid");
						else
							panel.setTopControl("config", "form");
						selectedTemplate = panel.getElement("template", index);
						//updateURL();
						return;
					}
				}
			} catch(err) {
			}
			combo.select(0);
			panel.setTopControl("config", "custom");
			selectedTemplate = null;
		}

		function chooseTemplate(name, control, element, event) {
			if(control.getSelection()) {
				index = control.getSelectionIndex();
				if(index == 0) {
					panel.setTopControl("config", "custom");
					selectedTemplate = null;
				} else {
					if (index == 3)
						panel.setTopControl("config", "form_embedded");
					else if (index == 6)
						panel.setTopControl("config", "form_solid");
					else
						panel.setTopControl("config", "form");
					selectedTemplate = panel.getElement(name, index);
				}
				config.setParameter("custom.form", "" + index);
				updateURL();
			}
		}

		function updateURL(name, control, element, event) {
			// -- The jdbcSource/jdbcDriver in the custom panel are bound to the config
			// -- parameters so we only have to update the UI controls to trigger the update
			// -- of the config.

			// -- generate the ULR format for the driver type
			if(selectedTemplate != null) {
				template = panel.getControl("template").getSelectionIndex();
				port = panel.getText("port");
				if(template == 3) {
					database = panel.getText("database2");
					hostname = "";
				} else if (template == 6) {
					database = panel.getText("database");
					hostname = panel.getText("hostname2");
					port = panel.getText("port2");
				} else {
					database = panel.getText("database");
					hostname = panel.getText("hostname");
				}
				url = selectedTemplate.getAttribute("url");
				url = url.replace("{hostname}", hostname);
				if(port.length() > 0)
					port = ":" + port;
				url = url.replace("{:port}", port);
				url = url.replace("{database}", database);
	
				// -- Update custom fields and config
				panel.setText("jdbcDriver", selectedTemplate.getAttribute("driver"));
				panel.setText("jdbcSource", url);
				
				if(name != null && control != null) {
					config.setParameter("custom." + name, control.getText());
				}
			} else {
				config.setParameter("custom.form", null);
			}
		}

	</Script>

</Panel>
